in_marathi.name: Ganesan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ganesan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ganesan is the name of the Hindu god with an elephant head, who is the remover of obstacles and the god of wisdom and knowledge. He is also known as Lord Ganesha or Vinayaka. This name represents power, wisdom, and good fortune.
